QF.id: XIII Trading, Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_59

question.text: A brokerage firm wants to offer algorithmic trading to its institutional clients on equity derivatives. Based on the workbook's framework, which of the following is NOT a requirement for deploying algo trading?

answer.text: Each individual algorithm must be approved by SEBI before deployment
The algorithm must be tested and certified by the exchange before deployment
Adequate risk management controls must be built into the broker's order-management system
Prior permission of the stock exchange is required, and algo orders must be routed through the broker's servers (with periodic system audit)

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI sets the overall algo-trading framework but does NOT individually approve each algorithm before deployment - that is the false statement and therefore the correct answer to "NOT a requirement". The other three are genuine requirements supported across NISM Series-VIII (December 2025) pp.142-145 and Series-I (December 2025) pp.130-132: exchange-level testing/certification of the algo, broker-side risk controls, prior exchange permission with orders routed through broker servers plus periodic system audit. The Trap: Confusing exchange-level conformance testing with SEBI-level approval of each algorithm is the common error. The audit flagged the original because option D ("must have co-location or proximity hosting") was also not a mandatory algo requirement in the workbook - the source lists lease line, VSAT, co-location, internet, etc. as alternative connection modes - which made two options defensible as "not required" and left no unique answer. Note: The original was ambiguous because option D (mandatory co-location/proximity hosting) was also not a true algo requirement, so two options were defensibly "NOT required". Option D has been replaced with an actually-required item (prior exchange permission, routing through broker servers, periodic system audit) drawn from Series-VIII pp.142-145, leaving only "individual SEBI approval of each algo" as a non-requirement.
